name: Renaissance Square
demographics: Renaissance Square serves a diverse Fort Worth community with a broad demographic mix spanning working-class to middle-income households. The trade area attracts value-conscious shoppers seeking everyday essentials and convenient services, with a customer base that includes young families, working professionals, and budget-minded consumers. The center's Walmart anchor draws a high volume of weekly shoppers prioritizing affordability and one-stop shopping convenience, typical of suburban Fort Worth's growing population corridors.
description: Renaissance Square is a community shopping center located at 2900 Renaissance Drive in Fort Worth, Texas, serving as a convenient retail destination for the surrounding neighborhoods. Anchored by Walmart, the center provides essential shopping services and everyday necessities to the local community. The property operates with extended hours from 6:00 AM to 11:00 PM, offering accessibility for shoppers throughout the day. With a solid 4.1-star rating from over 3,000 reviews, Renaissance Square has established itself as a reliable shopping destination in the Fort Worth area. The center's strategic location along Renaissance Drive provides easy access for residents seeking convenient retail services and money services in a practical shopping environment.
summary: Renaissance Square is a Walmart-anchored community center in Fort Worth, Texas, offering convenient everyday shopping and services. Operating from 6 AM to 11 PM with a 4.1-star rating, it serves as a practical retail destination for the local community.
